accounting_correction.by: owner instruction, 2026-09-22: the cohort loss stop must not treat gross confirmed BUY outflow as loss
accounting_correction.label: COHORT1_ECONOMICS_CORRECTION_V1
accounting_correction.new_measure: settlement-inclusive: fill spend + confirmed fees - settlement payout - confirmed rebates, SETTLED windows only. A profitable window carries a negative loss.
accounting_correction.old_measure: sum of total_spend_usd -- gross confirmed BUY outflow, which is TURNOVER and accumulates at about half of turnover whether the cohort wins or loses
accounting_correction.realized_note: +1.14 is settlement-IMPLIED. No attributable cash movement has been read back from the account.
accounting_correction.unrecoverable_note: gross outflow, recorded because it is known. NOT established loss and NOT carried forward into the cap as though it were.

economics.label: GEMINI_COHORT_ECONOMICS_V1
economics.labels: cumulative_economic_loss_usd is the ONLY field the aggregate stop reads, and it sums SETTLED windows only. A profitable window carries a NEGATIVE loss and reduces it. Pending windows contribute nothing -- their risk lives in the per-market gates. Unrecoverable windows contribute nothing and are never estimated from turnover. REALIZED stays null until attributable cash is read back.

label: GEMINI_L5_COHORT_RUNNER_V1
labels: windows_observed counts CONTRACTS BOUND. A contract that produced no fill is an observed window and is not a failure: nothing in this runner requires a trade to happen, and no parameter is tuned between windows.

prior_stop.note: an AUTHORIZED stop, reached because the CLI never wired the ledger chain and both windows drew on one 12-slot budget
prior_stop.why: the cohort's action budget is spent (12/12)

prior_stop_2.note: an AUTHORIZED stop, fired on the turnover measure corrected above. The stop is preserved, not erased. `stopped` stays TRUE: clearing it is an OWNER decision, not a consequence of fixing the arithmetic.
prior_stop_2.why: AGGREGATE_LOSS: reconstructed aggregate loss 10.63 has reached the cohort cap of 10.00

recovery.label: COHORT1_RECOVERY_V1
recovery.note: the twelve slots are reserved so they cannot be spent twice. They reconstruct no trade. The 3.77 is carried forward into the $10.00 aggregate cap rather than reset.
recovery.why: run 35671834127 stopped on an authorized condition, exited 1, and its evidence commit was skipped, so the ledger rows and the report died with the runner

resumed.by: owner instruction, 2026-09-22: resume the remaining 8 windows
resumed.note: `stopped` is cleared because the OWNER resumed this cohort after the orchestration defect was fixed. The stop itself is preserved above and is not erased.

stop_why: AGGREGATE_LOSS: reconstructed aggregate loss 10.63 has reached the cohort cap of 10.00

unrecoverable.label: GEMINI_COHORT_ECONOMICS_V1
unrecoverable.labels: gross outflow is recorded because it is known. ECONOMIC LOSS IS NOT ESTABLISHED: settlement was never observed, and gross buy outflow is turnover, not loss. It is excluded from the cohort's loss counter rather than carried forward as though it were a loss.
unrecoverable.why: run 35671834127 stopped on an authorized condition, exited 1 and skipped its evidence commit, so the symbols, per-action ledger and window reports of its two windows died with the runner. Their settlement was never observed.

windows.labels: RECOVERED FACTS ONLY. 3.77 is the runner's own reconstructed loss -- cash out of the account from confirmed fills, with no settlement credit, no matched-pair offset and no rebate assumed. It is NOT REALIZED: no attributable cash movement has been read back for it. Nothing in `what_is_NOT_known` is reconstructed, estimated or inferred anywhere in this file.
what_is_NOT_known: the two bound symbols and their entry TTEs
the per-cycle decision record and desired surfaces
every placement, ACK, fill, cancel and its price/size/id
per-window inventory, matched inventory and peak imbalance
which of the two windows produced which part of the 3.77

what_is_known.cohort_stop_why: the cohort's action budget is spent (12/12)
what_is_known.source: the runner's own stdout summary, the only record that survived; the report and per-window artifacts were written to the runner's disk and lost

fee_provenance.note: an execution with no `n` contributes nothing and is COUNTED here: absent is unknown, never zero

economics.rebates_note: CREDITED rebates only. None read back means None, not zero: an assumed rebate is exactly the kind of number that makes a bad trade look profitable.
